title: CRM
description: Leads with response times and qualification, a stage-based pipeline where every open deal has a next step, accounts and contacts with roles on each deal, products, activities, win and loss analysis, and a sales dashboard.

values.title: LegacySuite CRM
values.strengths: Broad partner network and familiar reporting templates.
values.weaknesses: Slow customization cycle and high per-seat licensing cost.
values.howtowin: Highlight fast object modeling, transparent pricing, and unified workflow automation.
